newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends up on currency, more demand talk.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends up on currency, more demand talk.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICALS

PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices moved up at close as sentiment was aided by speculation of supportive July crop by Ivan Wong sometimes this week. Technical buying also emerged after October futures broke the 1,180 ringgit. Expectation of increased demand firmed prices. Oct support is 1,170 and resistance 1,200.
PALM OIL PHYSICALS - The market saw somw covering from refiners and local dealers covered their positions.
"We expect Ivan to re-adjust end-July stock level. We think that the stock should be around 800,000 and 820,000 tonnes," a trader said.
Fuelled by the ringgit's weakness, the market also moved up in fairly volatile trading. "It ringgit falls further, we should see more export business because of cheaper prices." a trader said.
Traders expect some enquiries from buyers in the products and cash market where some refiners have been seen covering their positions ahead of strong leads.

Technically, the market looks optimistic in the near-term after third month October futures broke the 1,180 ringgit. At the close, the contract ended seven ringgit up at 1,184 ringgit ($449.84) a tonne.

Physicals August was offered at 1,212.50 ringgit a tonne against bids of 1,210. It was traded at 1,207.50 and 1,210. Aug (central) saw offers at 1,205 against bids of 1,200 with trades done at 1,195 and 1,200.
Sept (south) saw offers at 1,212.50 ringgit against bids of 1,210 with trades done at 1,210.
In refined palm oil, Aug RBD palm oil was offered at $487.50 a tonne FOB Malaysia, Sept at $487.50 and Oct/Nov/Dec at $485.
August RBD palm olein saw offers at $525, Sept at $522.50 and Oct/Nov/Dec at $522.50. August was traded at $520 and $524, Sept $519, $520 and Oct/Nov/Dec at $518,$519 and $520.
Aug/Sept RBD palm stearin was offered $365 a tonne, and Aug/Sept RBD palm fatty acid distillate saw offers at $290. --Tan Lee Lee (603-275-6834) ($1=2.6320 ringgit)
